scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Nestor out/nestor-demo.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --codec h264 --crf 14 --x264-preset slow --image-format png --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --overwrite && node scripts/finish.mjs out/nestor-demo.mp4
scripts.render:4k: remotion render src/index.ts Nestor out/nestor-demo-4k.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --codec h264 --scale 2 --crf 14 --x264-preset slow --image-format png --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --concurrency 6 --overwrite && node scripts/finish.mjs out/nestor-demo-4k.mp4
scripts.thumb: remotion still src/index.ts Nestor out/nestor-demo-thumb.png --frame=60 --image-format png --overwrite --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" && remotion still src/index.ts Nestor out/.thumb-4k.png --frame=60 --scale 2 --image-format png --overwrite --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/nestor-demo-thumb.png -vf scale=1280:720 -q:v 2 out/nestor-demo-thumb.jpg && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/.thumb-4k.png -q:v 3 out/nestor-demo-thumb-4k.jpg && rm -f out/.thumb-4k.png
